agentProfiles.name: scout
agentProfiles.notes: Read-only local discovery. Native command binds scout instructions and inspection tools.

agentProfiles.name: researcher
agentProfiles.notes: Read-only documentation and dependency research. Local inspection only until approved existing web tools are explicitly configured.

agentProfiles.name: worker
agentProfiles.notes: One approved bounded writer. Targeted checks only. Parent owns six total normal attempts.

agentProfiles.name: reviewer
agentProfiles.notes: Independent read-only revision and diff review. Retain for compatible follow-ups.

agentProfiles.name: oracle
agentProfiles.notes: Read-only diagnosis and technical judgment. Retain for compatible follow-ups. One diagnosis after normal worker exhaustion.

agentProfiles.name: worker-recovery
agentProfiles.notes: Bounded recovery writer after oracle diagnosis. Parent owns four total recovery attempts.

pi-scout.label: scout
command: Assigned role: scout. Read the Shared contract and scout section in /home/node/.pi/agent/roles/specialists.md before work. Perform only the assigned task. Do not delegate.

pi-researcher.label: researcher
command: Assigned role: researcher. Read the Shared contract and researcher section in /home/node/.pi/agent/roles/specialists.md before work. External web tools are unavailable in this launch. Report that gap. Perform only the assigned task. Do not delegate.

pi-worker.label: worker
command: Assigned role: worker. Read the Shared contract and worker section in /home/node/.pi/agent/roles/specialists.md before work. Read the rtk skill before direct RTK commands. Perform only the approved bounded task and targeted checks. Do not delegate.

pi-reviewer.label: reviewer
command: Assigned role: reviewer. Read the Shared contract and reviewer section in /home/node/.pi/agent/roles/specialists.md before work. Read ponytail and code-review-pyramid for review. Inspect the approved revision and diff. Remain read-only. Do not delegate.

pi-oracle.label: oracle
command: Assigned role: oracle. Read the Shared contract and oracle section in /home/node/.pi/agent/roles/specialists.md before work. Read ponytail for simplification analysis. Remain read-only. Do not delegate.

pi-worker-recovery.label: worker-recovery
command: Assigned role: worker-recovery. Read the Shared contract and worker-recovery section in /home/node/.pi/agent/roles/specialists.md before work. Read the attempt record and oracle diagnosis. Read ponytail and rtk when applicable. Perform only approved recovery changes and targeted checks. Do not delegate.
